notes.title: v2.0 Brand New version, Biggest Update Ever
notes.notes:
v2.0 is a brand new version that supports multiplayer mode, new map, realistic island landscape and plants, new build system, crafting system, planting system,  new UI design, which is equivalent to redevelop a brand new game, and V1.0 is still available for you to choose, and the old archives will not be affected. You can choose to switch between different versions to play. Due to a lot of work. This is the biggest update since the game was released and took a lot of work and testing, This is why it took so long for the update to be released
About V2:
New maps: brand new and more realistic vegetation and new landscapes, dense and dangerous tropical jungles, realistic coconut trees and nearly 60 kinds of various tropical plants, natural wind, 4K textures and high quality materials. A lot of optimizations, if you have a high-performance graphics card, you can easily get a high frame rate of 120fps at a resolution of 1080p, even in a jungle with dense vegetation, you can get a high frame rate of nearly 100FPS, please turn on vertical sync to reduce GPU consumption
New Build system:
More abundant and free building modules can be built, and buildings with more complex structures can be built. New triangular walls and foundations, you can upgrade wooden walls, stone walls and iron walls, and can make decorations hanging on the walls such as lamps. The door lock function can be set with a password in multiplayer mode to prevent others from intruding. You can make C4 or bomb to blow up the building, and you will see the real physical fragmentation effect. Decorations such as carpets and wall paintings will be updated in the future.
 NPC trading system:
You can find a survivor NPC on the initial island, you can sell wood, ore and other resources to him to get gold coins, and then buy some useful items from him. Accumulating coins is a lot of fun.
New weapons: 
several new firearms and throwable explosives, etc.
Dynamic weather:
3D cloud sky, day and night cycle system, rainy and sunny and cloudy weather, ground and plant puddles wet effect, rain water creates puddles on the ground, and will dry up slowly after the weather is sunny, characters walk in puddles to produce ripples and splashes .
Multi-archive management:
You can customize the archive name and select the archive to load and overwrite, delete the archive
Multiplayer mode:
When you enter the game in multiplayer mode, other steam players can see your server and join the game. Your nickname is the server name. Note that due to engine coding problems,  some languages like chinese  nickname is displayed as garbled characters, while the English name or numbers can be can display normal.  Note: In the current multiplayer mode, the character customization multiplayer replicate function is not perfect and only shows your own customized appearance. Due to the complexity of the character customization system and the need to upload steam to test the multiplayer mode, these functions will be improved and updated in the future. In addition, the custom server name, password protection and other functions of the multiplayer mode will be improved in the future, please wait patiently for the update.
 Is v1 still playable? 
All the content of V1 is kept in V2, which will not affect your old archives. If you are more used to v1, you can still play the content of v1 as before. And v2 will be a major version for future updates.
 Why release v2? 
Since v1 is specially designed for single-player mode, the system design has certain limitations and flaws, which lead to slow progress in the update work, such as flaws in the data structure, resulting in having to add data multiple times for each tool, in order not to damage the overall project and archive, so features cannot be modified on a large scale.
For further development of the future, a new version of V2 is launched. V2 is equivalent to the redevelopment of most of the core content, compatible with single-player and multi-player modes.
 More new content will be updated continuously, there will be new maps with more types of landforms, more types of animals, etc.,  Merry Christmas! Best regards

notes.title: Alpha0.58: BUG fix and improve
notes.notes:
Bug fix:
Fixed the problem that the hammer re-select building types,Now it will continue to maintain the selected state.

Fixed problems with campfires and furnace burning, eating and drinking, building, whistling and other sound effects can't be set.

Fixed a bug where the player could still slide while sleeping.

Fixed an issue where using the mouse wheel to still switch the camera after opening the inventory interface.

Fixed the problem of weapons destroying buildings, because in order to be compatible with the first person, weapons have a wide range of attacks, so sometimes it will accidentally damage the building. Now if you want to demolish the built things, you can only destroy them by X when hold harmer.

Fixed a collision problem with climbing stairs

Improve:
Now you can close the crafting and inventory interface by pressing ESC. Press again to open the pause menu. You can also use ESC to close the game guide and planting interface.

The button for making the animal specimen has been modified to F. This is because you may press E or pick up arrows but make specimen 

Added support for 4K resolution displays (3840x2160),The resolution will automatically be set according to your screen resolution.

Now you can set Invert mouse Y-Axis\X-Axis in the control, you need to reload the game in the in-game graphics settings. Reduced mouse sensitivity, there is no way to adjust the sensitivity in the game, you can adjust the sensitivity by pressing the button on your mouse.

When the player is more than 50 meters away from the puppy, the puppy's name will be hidden. If you don't like the puppy, you don't need to call it.

Add small icon UI to the wooden bed, raft, and fishing trap to prompt its location. You can build a bed marker home in your house.

The white marks of hunger or thirst to death are more visible.

Building module LOD optimization to save performance.

Modify the color of the character red panties to black.

notes.title: Alpha0.51: New pet puppy and bug fix
notes.notes:

New content:
Add a puppy: black shadow, you can rescue it from the stone of the starting island, it will follow you, accompany you to hunt and protect you, the dog will be attacked or killed by carnivorous animals, It will be revived after reloading the game. When you leave it a hundred meters away, it will reappear around you, so don't worry about your puppy being lost.

Adding health bar to animals shows health values, you can better judge and hunt.

Add footsteps to the playe character and  sound of opening the door. Different footsteps will be emitted on different grounds or objects, such as walking sounds on beaches, grass, shallow water and wooden floors, brick floors, etc.

Add 2 new random sound cycles for marine environment sound effect to the ocean.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34324870/7ff8b0f65987bcaaf60bfdce531aa06b08e996d6.png

Shortened the time between the two bows and the full bow.

Remove the wild boar and scorpion from the starting island. The only animal that threatens you is a goat.

Fixed the problem that when you open the campfire or furnace, press shift + left mouse click on the items in the inventory will disappear, but the campfire and the furnace can only drag the items into the corresponding space to process, shift + left click on the mouse Transfer items quickly.

notes.title: Alpha 0.25 Major update and Hotfix
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34324870/a6bd63d5867511006857d2ede98b813ee2635ed0.png
New content:
*There are two types of torches. One of them can be used as a decoration and lighting on a building. Of course, it can be placed anywhere. If you don't want it, you can destroy it with a weapon. The other can be used for lighting in hand, only the hand-held torch will burn and loss of durability when used. Torch crafted  requires little resources and cannot be repaired.
*New wooden boxes can be used to store resources, food, weapons, etc. Right-click and long press to pick up the wooden box and place it anywhere. You can put the storage box on the raft to start a long journey.
*A new wooden bed can be used to store the respawn point after death, just like the shelter. However, in the cold zone, grassland and other areas, there is no coconut tree to get leaf, and the wooden bed can be built only by wood. If you travel far away,it is best to build a bed or shelter to save the respawn point.
Bug fix:
*Fixed a problem that the PC below the 1080P resolution could not be fully displayed in the game's HUD interface. If your notebook is 1366×768 resolution or lower resolution,Now, the computer can run the game perfectly.
*Fixed a bug that just quits the game and then loads it and causes no start items.
*If you encounter the problem of creating something disappearing, this is because the craft system deducts the resources in the backpack after the craft time is completed, so if you drop or consume the resources when craftting, it will cause the craft time to end without creating anything. .
*Fixed a bug that could not water the planted trees at long distance or deduct water but could not be watered too far.
*Game will be automatically saved after 30 seconds, if you just respawn and quit the game, it will cause the backpack to be empty after loading into the game.Now.it will be saved when you quit the game.
*Fixed resource usage and resource type errors in building and upgrading stairs .
Optimization improvements:
*Adjusted the day and night circulation system, increased the length of the day, reduced the length of the night, I hope you can light the bonfire, cook or look at the saplings you planted, calm down to appreciate the beautiful moonlight and starry sky, the future will increase by sleeping skip night function,
*The weather system has been adjusted to increase the probability of occurrence of sunny days and reduce the probability of rain and cloudy weather. There are more than a dozen random changes in the current weather.
*Improve the collision and physical simulation of melee weapons. Now you can use axe to slash animal corpses and other objects for more realistic physical collision feedback. Remember that the right mouse button is your invisible hand. Click and long press to drag the animal carcass and other simulated physical objects to any place.
*Adjust the properties of meat, small fish and other foods, which will increase the difficulty of survival, you need to go to the farther island to find more food to fill the hunger. Improve the efficacy of the herb to increase the health value.
*Reduce the attack power of the viper, drop 99 blood to 50 from one mouth, don't worry, the snake bites you and ran away.
I look forward to your simple positive review of this game, it will give me tremendous motivation to continuously update more content, thank you!

notes.title: Alpha 0.2 Major update and improvements
notes.notes:
New content:
New Big raft, very fast,It is like sailing a yacht on the sea. When you are finished building, you can now operate the raft more flexibly and get ready to start long distance adventures. Well, huge islands and land, the forest is waiting for you to explore.
Iron Axe and Pickaxe can be crafted from smelted iron, and iron resources can be smelted from the stone through the furnace. Iron Axe is sharp and the attack power is stronger, and the Pickaxe  collects stones faster.
Add crocodile skin resources, now the backpack can be crafted , you can get 10 crocodile skins after killing the adult saltwater crocodile, and you can get 5 crocodile skins by killing the small crocodile. Large backpacks add 25 backpack  slots, and small backpacks add 10 slots.
There are more animals placed around the island. Now you can find wild boars, hares, snakes, deer, goats, crocodiles, mice  on the island near the birthplace without going to the far islands. You can also find apple trees. Bamboo forest and several other trees, mushrooms and herbs are mostly under the tree, please look carefully. If you are going to find the New World far away, you can find apple forests , pine forests and spectacular coconut coasts, as well as tropical jungles.

Bug fix:
Solved the problem that the axe can not be cut down continuously.Now you can also cut down trees by long pressing the mouse.

Improve and optimization:
When the coconut is opened, eating half a coconut can add 15 health values. When you get the coconut, it is best to cut the coconut to save the backpack space and update the introduction of the coconut in the backpack.
Improve the distance and range of the flashlight, improve the damage range of the fish spear, and improve the attack power of the axe.
Reduces the health of crocodiles and wild boars and reduces their attack power.
Improve the amount of bottled water can be stack. No longer each bottle of water take a backpack slot. After you get the water from the water collector, drag the bottle to another bottle of water in the backpack to stack the amount.
Add a new sound of  weapen to open the the coconut .
More stones, trees and other resources have been added to nearby islands, reducing the time of reborn time after the collection of resources such as stones and mushroom.
Slows down the rate of hunger and thirst. It consumes food and water more slowly in idle state. Jogging consumes more food and water.
Reduce the amount of wood used to make rafts, update the introduction and operation instructions of the raft, make the raft and put it on the ground, click on the raft and long press the right mouse button to drag it into the ocean.
Reduces the weight of some items.
Add new buttons to operate the walking direction. For example, if you are used to holding the mouse with your left hand and the right hand pressing the keyboard to control walking, you only need to press the up, down, left, and right arrow keys on the right side of the keyboard, or the number on the numeric keypad.8, 5, 4, 6
Thank you for your support ,best wishes to you ！

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.2 New Update and Hotfix
notes.notes:
1. Add a flashlight and water to the player's starting items, improve the buildding system, cancel the blueprint, build the house with only a hammer and upgrade to destroy the building. (When you cut down the coconut tree to get the wood, equip the hammer and press the F button to build House, R key rotates to build angle, close to building Q key to upgrade and destroy
2. Fixed the issue of archiving. The game is automatically archived every 30 seconds. When you update the game, you can start a new game or manually delete the old archive and then play the new game. Archive location: C:\Users\your username\AppData \Local\MyIsland\Saved\SaveGames)
3. Place saltwater crocodile, wild boar, hare and other animals on the island near the starting point of the player (other animals such as deer,bear, wolf, and goat on distant land), add Herbal medicine and several  broadleaf plants, and three kinds of mushrooms. More plants such as coconut trees and other trees. try to travel far away，you will find a new continent, connected by several large islands, rich in coconut trees，grassland and frigid forests, as well as crocodiles, deer, wolves, bears, hares and other animals, if you don't like life at the beach,just going to land to explore, because most of the Player has no patience to play this game, I have to put some animals and resources to the start place, these small islands are just on the edge of the map, you can find more magnificent landscape by travel .
4. Modify the water collection time of the water collector, shortening from 5 minutes to collect a bottle of water every 2 minutes, improving the amount of wood needed to build a part of the house, reducing the coconut leaves needed to build a simple shelter (the shelter is very Important, you can save the location after death and reborn, and in the future will add bed to save).
5. Fixed the problem that the great white shark chased the player to fly out of the sea, and increased the effect of sharks and crocodiles, wild boars and other animals attacking  player to splashing blood.  Improve the color of the water on the sea floor, brighter and fresher in color
6. Improve the attack distance of weapons such as axe, you can also cut down without too close to the tree (currently you can only click the left mouse button to cut down, you can't press the left mouse button to cut down continuously, this small bug will be solved later), Cancel game difficulty selection, repair and optimization of the inventory system.
7. Updated the game guide, you can find the game guide documentation on the island where the game starts or in the menu bar.

We will continue to update new content and fix bugs in the future, thank you for your support!  Welcome your feedback,Thank you！

notes.title: Emergency Hotfix Patch v0.11 fixes several bugs
notes.notes:
If you have already purchased, please be sure to delete all the archives of the game and start over! The archive directory（AppData Maybe hidden） is in C:\Users\your username\AppData\Local\MyIsland\Saved\SaveGames
Fixed a bug where the game was saved and the player was not in the original position. The game is automatically saved every 30 seconds and does not need to be saved manually.
Fixed the problem that the coconut kept rolling into the ocean. The coconut needs to be opened with a weapon to eat. The open coconut can save the backpack space.
Modification of wind and ocean wave cycles, modification of weather change speed.
Added a game guide at the player's starting point.
(Because I have already returned to my hometown for Chinese New Year Holiday, I have to take more than 100 kilometers to get back to the office to fix the bug. If you have already bought a bad experience because of the bug, please forgive me, thank you~)
Thank you for your support and feedback,Happy New Year!
